rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states that two or more separately named activities are each performed only if necessary, so that any combination of them, including only one or none, may occur before the flow continues: Model an inclusive split gateway before the conditional activities, with one outgoing flow to each activity, and an inclusive join gateway after them, before the next step, so the join waits only for the branches that were activated. Do not use an exclusive gateway, which would allow only one activity, and do not use a parallel gateway, which would force all of them to run.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states that two or more separately named activities are each performed only if necessary, so that any combination of them, including only one or none, may occur before the flow continues

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description says a participant asks several outside parties to submit proposals and then chooses one, without describing those parties' own behavior or any exchange in their own process: Model the requests and the receipt of the proposals as tasks in the requesting participant's own lane or pool, and the choice as a gateway or task in that same participant's lane. Do not create a separate pool for the outside parties, and do not add message flows from the requesting participant's tasks to them or from them back to the receiving task.

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states that one or more optional activities, each performed only if needed, are attributed to a named role or department that is shown as a lane, and a gateway splits to them and joins them again: Place the inclusive split gateway and the inclusive join gateway for these optional activities in the lane of the role that performs or decides on them, not in a lane of another role or outside the lanes. Keep the gateway type inclusive, as the optional activities can occur in any combination. Give each gateway exactly one lane, following the stated responsibility.
